posts.title: What Am I Actually Doing All Day?
posts.description: AI made me more productive, and I ended up hanging on to the endless work it produces. I want fewer decisions I need not make, and more time for the ones I must.

posts.title: Learning Again
posts.description: After 18 years in embedded I moved into robotics. Choosing to be a learner again gave me a direction: helping solo makers finish real hardware products.

posts.title: How I Keep Speed, Quality and Intent with AI Agents
posts.description: I build NeuroTerm, an embedded terminal, alone with Claude Code and Codex. Written intents and a two-week release train keep speed, quality and intent.
